description: NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 1.1B compiled to CoreML and run through Apple's Neural Engine/GPU dispatch with no PyTorch dependency. This fighter runs the fp16 quantization tier for English.
notes: Quantization-tier variant: fp16/int8/4bit/6bit are meaningfully different fighters on the accuracy/footprint curve, not just packaging. macOS-only (CoreML); requires an Apple Silicon runner to score.
